acquisition_method.evidence: Data independent acquisition (DIA) mass spectrometer settings were as follows: one 120,000 resolution full MS scan with a scan range of 350-1200 m/z, normalized automatic gain control (AGC) target of 300%, and automatic maximum inject time.
we injected standard E. coli protein digest in between samples (one injection after every four biological samples) and collected the data in data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
